newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE to reach for 4,590 then may fade.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE to reach for 4,590 then may fade.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index may be able to go up towards 4,590 on Wednesday before fading once more, technical analysts said.

The market looks to have halted its descent of the past five days with support coming in at about 4,520. It may be possible that investors may be willing to take some risk at this stage which would push the index a little higher before a twinge of nervousness hits the market once more, they added.
Investor interest may be shown in some bank and pharmaceutical stocks which have been dull performers recently.
By 0720 GMT, the FTSE was indicated up 4.5 at 4,562.3.
Trendlines on the FTSE -- which connect its intra-day highs and lows on a daily bar chart over the past five days -- have been falling at a rate of 35 points a day, analysts noted.
The market is now near trendline resistance and as a result may take a little time to successfully break above it.
But encouraging signs come from short-term oscillators -- such as the 10 day momentum -- which have bounced from extremely low readings and this should indicate the FTSE is due for a rebound.
The FTSE's 10 day momentum is currently giving a reading of minus 40 having been minus 130 on Monday.
